data.title: sprint close --carry-to records the carried tasks in the closing event
data.why: Sprint membership is one field on the task, so once a carried task points at the next sprint only the closing event still says it was taken into this one and not finished. sprintReport reads that list, so velocity, committed and carried-over of a closed sprint do not change after the fact (I5).
data.rejected: Re-derive membership from sprint.task_added history: every report would replay events, outside the fold; Leave unfinished work in the closed sprint and let people re-add it: Scrum's carry-over becomes a chore nobody does
